query: LongMemEval 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: LongMemEval 是一个综合基准，用于评估聊天助手的五项核心长期记忆能力：信息提取、多会话推理、时间推理、知识更新和拒答，包含 500 个精心策划的问题。
support_quote: We introduce LONGMEMEVAL, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate five core long-term memory abilities of chat assistants: information extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention.
title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory

query: LongMemEval 如何为每个问题构建聊天历史？
answer: LongMemEval 为每个问题编译一段连贯的用户-AI 聊天历史：采样无关会话，将证据会话随机插入中间，并为所有会话分配合理的时间戳。
support_quote: Specifically, we sample a number of unrelated user-AI chat sessions, randomly insert the evidence sessions in the middle, and assign a plausible timestamp to all sessions.
title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory

query: LongMemEval 实验中主要使用了哪些模型和检索器？
answer: 实验主要研究 GPT-4o、Llama 3.1 70B Instruct 和 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 三个 LLM，检索器选用 1.5B 的 Stella V5 稠密检索模型。
support_quote: We mainly study three LLMs: GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, and Llama 3.1 8B Instruct3. For the retriever, we choose dense retrieval with the 1.5B Stella V5 model
title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory

query: LongMemEval 中商业记忆增强聊天助手表现如何？
answer: 商业记忆增强聊天助手表现较弱：ChatGPT 和 Coze 相比直接用同一 LLM 离线阅读上下文，准确率大幅下降，其中以 GPT-4o 实例化的两者分别下降 37% 和 64%。
support_quote: Specifically, ChatGPT and Coze instantiated with GPT-4o exhibits 37% and 64% performance drop, respectively.
title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory

query: LongMemEval 提出的时间感知查询扩展对检索效果有何提升？
answer: 时间感知索引与查询扩展在值取轮次时平均提升召回率 11.3%，值取会话时提升 6.8%，且在索引阶段应用键扩展时该提升保持一致。
support_quote: this simple design improves recall by an average of 11.3% when using rounds as the value and by 6.8% when using sessions as the value.
title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
